artworks.title: Beggar with a Stick, Walking to the Left
artworks.description: This image shows a side view of a person walking with a staff. The individual is slightly hunched, stepping forward. Their facial features include a prominent nose and a contemplative expression. The person wears a pointed hat, a cloak or overcoat with folds, loose pants, and low shoes. The background features abstract lines resembling foliage.

artworks.title: Beggar with His Left Hand Extended
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in profile, facing right. The figure is hunched forward, one hand extended outward and the other hidden. The face shows detailed features, including a prominent nose and a pensive expression with age or concentration lines. The person wears a turban-like hat, and a fur-trimmed cloak drapes over their body. The cloak is slightly open, revealing some underlying clothing. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure and cross-hatched textures. In the top left corner, there is a small inscription saying "RE 1631."

artworks.title: The Blindness of Tobit: a Sketch
artworks.description: The image shows a person in full length from a side view, looking into a doorway or alcove. The person is slightly bent over, with their face turned towards the door, making it hard to see clear facial features. They are wearing a long coat with a cape-like collar and a wide-brimmed hat that covers their hair. The outfit suggests a historical or period style of dress. The person is using their left hand to interact with the door. No visible jewelry is present, and the background consists of a textured wall with no other discernible details.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait in a Fur Cap
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a person in a frontal position. The individual has detailed facial features and curly hair, with a large fur-like hat. They have a serious expression and wear textured clothing. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Circumcision: Small Plate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a glowing central figure. The scene is highly detailed, rendered in intricate line work, depicting a cloaked figure standing with a staff, overseeing a group. The central figure appears illuminated, enveloped in a warm aura. The characters are draped in textured robes, exchanging attentive, solemn gazes. The background features arches, with light appearing to radiate from the central figure, creating depths and shadows around the group. Every detail is carefully etched, conveying a sense of reverence and narrative depth.

artworks.title: The Presentation in the Temple with the Angel: Small Plate
artworks.description: This image shows a scene with numerous figures. In the center, a person in a long robe, visible from the side and nearly full-length, stands amidst a group. The person is leaning slightly forward, with one hand extended, amidst others, some of whom are kneeling or bending. Their facial features are finely etched, giving a sense of depth and expression, and the individual wears a head covering. Another figure near them has elaborate headwear. The surrounding individuals, varying in age and appearance, are depicted in detailed robes and outfits, rich with folds. Some figures seem to gesture or interact with one another, creating a dynamic composition. An angelic figure, distinguished by wings, appears amidst the assembly. The scene is set against a backdrop of intricate architectural elements, with a large curtain draped open and others in the distance engaged in conversation or observing the scene. The detailing suggests the setting could be an ancient or mythological venue, with a strong sense of texture and spatial arrangement lending depth to the depicted gathering.

artworks.title: Ragged Peasant with His Hands behind Him, Holding a Stick
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing. The individual is slightly hunched over with their right hand on their hip and their left hand holding a walking stick. The person has a mustache, closed eyes, and is wearing a cap. They have thick hair peeking from under the cap. The person is wearing a loose-fitting jacket and trousers that appear tattered. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Man in a Coat and Fur Cap Leaning against a Bank
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing with a staff. He has a beard and appears aged. He is wearing a textured hat, an unkempt hairstyle, and a long coat with a decorative edge. The background is a simple sketch of ground and foliage.

artworks.title: Beggar Man and Woman behind a Bank
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals shown from slightly above the knees upwards. They are both positioned in a walking stance, leaning forward with determined expressions. The man on the left has a large, round nose and is wearing a textured hat, with a head covering tied under his chin. His facial features show pronounced lines and a beard. He is wearing a coat or heavy garment and holds a cane firmly in one hand. The woman accompanying him is slightly bent, with a large bonnet that covers her hair, and her facial features are also marked by deep lines. She wears a long dress or apron suggesting layering and her hands are clasped in front of her. In the background, there is a densely textured area representing foliage or a bush.

artworks.title: Beggar Seated on a Bank
Beggar Leaning on a Stick, Facing Left
artworks.description: The image depicts an outline drawing of a person viewed from the side, capturing their entire body from head to toe. The individual is shown standing in a slightly hunched position with a walking stick in hand. The facial features are detailed with a pronounced nose and a forward glance, with the hair covered by a large headscarf. The clothing consists of layered, loose-fitting garments, and the background is a plain, lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Beggar Seated Warming His Hands at a Chafing Dish
Beggar Man and Beggar Woman Conversing
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals depicted in a sketch style, both visible from head to toe. They are positioned closely together, leaning forward towards one another, each supporting themselves with a cane. The person on the left is slightly taller, with a drawn expression on their face, prominent cheekbones, and wearing a hat that covers their hair. The clothing appears oversized and ragged, with a loose tunic and pants, and they have large, worn shoes. The individual on the right also has a drawn face with noticeable features and wears a hat with drooping sides. Their similar ragged clothing consists of a long coat or dress that reaches to their legs, which are partially visible. There is no visible jewelry or objects other than the canes they’re holding. The background is plain and lacks details, emphasizing the two figures as the focal point of the image.

artworks.title: The Artist's Mother, Head and Bust
artworks.description: The image is a portrait sketch showing the upper part of a person's body, focusing on the head, shoulders, and upper chest. The person is depicted in a seated position with a slight turn of the head to one side, displaying a serene expression on their face. The individual's facial features include soft lines and a gentle composition, enclosed by a few wavy lines indicating textured or styled hair. The hair appears to be somewhat voluminous and loosely draped to the sides. The attire consists of a cloak or robe with layered and textured fabric around the neckline. The sketch is presented on a plain background with subtle tonal variations, accentuating the details of the clothing and face without any additional context or objects featured in the surrounding space.

artworks.title: Old Beggar Woman with a Gourd
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a person in profile view facing left. The person appears to be in motion, with their facial features obscured by shadows. They are wearing a hat, layered clothing, and holding a round object in one hand. The sketchy lines and shading give texture to the clothing. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: Bust of an Old Woman in a Furred Cloak and Heavy Headdress
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a person, depicted from the chest upwards, in a three-quarter view facing to the right. The subject has an aged face with facial lines and a slightly furrowed brow. The eyes are partially closed, and the lips are pressed together. The person is wearing a textured cap or head covering, which appears to be fur-lined. The cap extends around the back, creating a voluminous silhouette. The clothing seems to be a heavy garment that wraps around the neck and shoulders. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the subject. The background is plain with some cross-hatching. The image maintains an old master-style etching that focuses on the detailed features of the person's face and attire.

artworks.title: Bald Man in a Fur Cloak
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of an elderly man, depicted from the shoulders up. His body is turned slightly to the left, in a three-quarter view. The man has a weathered face with visible wrinkles on his forehead and around his eyes, a defined nose, and a downturned mouth. His hair is thinning, revealing balding. He wears a garment with a fur collar. There are no objects or jewelry around him. The background is intricately shaded, and there is a signature and the year "1631" in the upper left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Bald Man with Open Mouth, Looking Down
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The etching depicts a man's upper body, focusing on his head and shoulders. The man faces slightly downwards with a hunched posture. His facial features include a prominent nose and textured beard. His head is mostly bald with short, sparse hair around the crown. He wears a garment draping over his shoulders, possibly a robe or cloak, indicated through sketch-like lines. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects. The background is plain, with a signature and date in the upper left corner: "Rembrandt" and "1631."

artworks.title: Bald Man with Open Mouth, Looking Down
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image shows the upper part of a person's body, specifically focusing on the head and upper torso. The person's head is tilted downward. The face is mostly obscured by shadow, with prominent facial features including a distinct nose and a slightly open mouth. The person has a receding hairline, with very little hair on top of the head, and more visible hair around the sides and a beard, depicted through intricately etched lines. They are wearing a garment that drapes over the shoulder, depicted with cross-hatched details indicating folds in the fabric. The background is plain, with signs of wear visible on the textured surface, including faint smudges or spots. There are inscriptions or markings at the top left area.

artworks.title: Bearded Man Looking Down
artworks.description: The etching depicts a man's upper body in a downward-facing position. His head is bent forward. He has a prominent forehead, wide nose, heavily bearded face, and thin, receding hair. He wears a dark garment. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain with cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies including Head of the Artist, a Beggar Couple, Heads of an Old Man and Old Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a partial etching of a person's face and shoulders, positioned in the upper half of the composition, with the head slightly turned to the viewer's right. The face features curly hair that extends outward, partially shadowing one of the eyes, and a soft expression with faint outlines and shading. The individual wears a wide-brimmed hat which casts shadows across the face. Below the main portrait are sketch-like figures, loosely drawn, suggesting other possible figure studies or incomplete works, with lines crossing and intersecting without definitive features. The background is an unfilled, light-toned space that highlights the etched lines without any detailed context or scenery.

artworks.title: The Persian
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing with a walking stick in his right hand. He has a long beard, bushy hair, and wears a hat with a feather. He is dressed in elaborate clothing, including a fur-lined cloak and patterned garment. He wears detailed shoes and a medallion around his neck. The background is minimally sketched.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. A man and woman are depicted from the waist up, standing close together. The man is on the left and has facial features with a beard and hair covered by a cap. The woman on the right wears a headscarf, looking down at a baby she holds in her arms. The baby's face is visible, wrapped in a cloth. Both adults wear robes with flowing sleeves. To the right, a draped garment or cloth hangs on the wall. The background features cross-hatched patterns for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Turbaned Soldier on Horseback
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a rider on a horse from behind. The person is seated upright on the horse, holding a long stick over their shoulder. The rider's face is not visible, and their clothing appears loose and flowing. The horse's front and hind legs are shown, with its tail drawn in flowing lines. To the left, there are loosely sketched shapes suggesting two additional figures. The background includes minimal details like foliage or trees.
